{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection3",
  "test_code": "using System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedFormattersAndResolvers_HaveExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace TempProject\n            {\n                public enum MyEnum\n                {\n                    A,\n                    B,\n                    C,\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public class IntKeyClass\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int IntProp { get; set; }\n\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public MyEnum EnumProp { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public struct IntKeyStruct\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int IntProp { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public record IntKeyRecord([property: Key(0)] int IntProp);\n\n                [MessagePackObject(true)]\n                public class StringKeyClass\n                {\n                    public string StrProp { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject(true)]\n                public struct StringKeyStruct\n                {\n                    public string StrProp { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject(true)]\n                public record StringKeyRecord(string StrProp);\n\n                [Union(0, typeof(UnionSubA))]\n                [Union(1, typeof(UnionSubB))]\n                public interface IMyUnion\n                {\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public class UnionSubA : IMyUnion\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int Value { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public class UnionSubB : IMyUnion\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public string Name { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = net80Refs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        ImmutableArray<GeneratedSourceResult> generatedSources = runResult.Results\n            .SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources)\n            .ToImmutableArray();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedSources);\n\n        var formattedTargetTypes = new HashSet<string>();\n        var resolverTypes = new List<string>();\n\n        foreach (GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource in generatedSources)\n        {\n            SemanticModel semanticModel = output.GetSemanticModel(generatedSource.SyntaxTree);\n            SyntaxNode root = await generatedSource.SyntaxTree.GetRootAsync();\n\n            foreach (TypeDeclarationSyntax typeDecl in root.DescendantNodes().OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>())\n            {\n                INamedTypeSymbol? symbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDecl);\n                if (symbol is null)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = symbol.AllInterfaces.FirstOrDefault(i =>\n                    i.OriginalDefinition.Name == \"IMessagePackFormatter\" &&\n                    i.ContainingNamespace.ToDisplayString() == \"MessagePack.Formatters\");\n\n                bool isResolver = symbol.AllInterfaces.Any(i =>\n                    i.Name == \"IFormatterResolver\" &&\n                    i.ContainingNamespace.ToDisplayString() == \"MessagePack\");\n\n                if (formatterInterface is not null || isResolver)\n                {\n                    bool hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage = symbol.GetAttributes().Any(attr =>\n                        attr.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n                    Assert.True(\n                        hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage,\n                        $\"Generated type '{symbol.ToDisplayString()}' in '{generatedSource.HintName}' must be decorated with [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n                }\n\n                if (formatterInterface is not null && formatterInterface.TypeArguments.Length == 1)\n                {\n                    formattedTargetTypes.Add(formatterInterface.TypeArguments[0].ToDisplayString());\n                }\n\n                if (isResolver)\n                {\n                    resolverTypes.Add(symbol.ToDisplayString());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Assert.NotEmpty(resolverTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.MyEnum\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.IntKeyClass\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.IntKeyStruct\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.IntKeyRecord\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.StringKeyClass\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.StringKeyStruct\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.StringKeyRecord\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.IMyUnion\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.UnionSubA\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TempProject.UnionSubB\", formattedTargetTypes);\n    }\n}\n"
}
